root_cause.text: In the error rollback path of octep_vf_request_irqs(), free_irq() was called with the wrong dev_id (`oct`) instead of the per-queue `ioq_vector` pointer used during request_irq(), leaving the irqaction registered and allowing a use-after-free when the ioq_vector is later freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `free_irq(oct->msix_entries[i].vector, oct)` to `free_irq(oct->msix_entries[i].vector, oct->ioq_vector[i])`, and the CVE description confirms that the dev_id mismatch "may leave the irqaction registered" and "can keep IRQ handlers alive while ioq_vector is later freed ... leading to a use-after-free or crash".
